name: nginx-multisite
description: Installs and configures Nginx for three SSL-enabled virtual hosts, including static content, TLS, security headers, rate limiting, Fail2ban, UFW, SSH hardening, and sysctl settings.

name: cache
description: Configures Memcached and Redis, including Redis authentication, logging, service enablement, and required post-configuration compatibility settings.

name: fastapi-tutorial
description: Deploys the FastAPI tutorial application with Python tooling, PostgreSQL database and user setup, a virtual environment, environment configuration, and a systemd service running Uvicorn.
